cat > /app/solution.sql <<'EOF'
WITH RECURSIVE
pkg AS (
  SELECT id, name FROM read_csv_auto('/app/packages.csv', header = true)
),
dep AS (
  SELECT package_id, depends_on_id FROM read_csv_auto('/app/dependencies.csv', header = true)
),
vuln AS (
  SELECT cve_id, package_name FROM read_csv_auto('/app/vulnerabilities.csv', header = true)
),
walk AS (
  SELECT
    v.cve_id,
    v.package_name AS vulnerable_package,
    dp.name AS affected_package,
    1 AS depth,
    [v.package_name, dp.name] AS path_list
  FROM vuln v
  JOIN pkg pv ON pv.name = v.package_name
  JOIN dep d ON d.depends_on_id = pv.id
  JOIN pkg dp ON dp.id = d.package_id

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    w.cve_id,
    w.vulnerable_package,
    dp.name,
    w.depth + 1,
    list_append(w.path_list, dp.name)
  FROM walk w
  JOIN pkg pa ON pa.name = w.affected_package
  JOIN dep d ON d.depends_on_id = pa.id
  JOIN pkg dp ON dp.id = d.package_id
  WHERE NOT list_contains(w.path_list, dp.name)
    AND w.depth < 35
),
exposure AS (
  SELECT
    cve_id,
    vulnerable_package,
    affected_package,
    min(depth) AS depth,
    min_by(array_to_string(path_list, ' -> '), depth) AS path
  FROM walk
  GROUP BY cve_id, vulnerable_package, affected_package
),
multi AS (
  SELECT
    affected_package AS package_name,
    count(DISTINCT cve_id) AS cve_count
  FROM walk
  GROUP BY affected_package
  HAVING count(DISTINCT cve_id) >= 2
)
SELECT
  'exposure' AS section,
  cve_id,
  vulnerable_package,
  affected_package,
  depth,
  path,
  NULL AS package_name,
  NULL AS cve_count
FROM exposure
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'multi_hit' AS section,
  NULL AS cve_id,
  NULL AS vulnerable_package,
  NULL AS affected_package,
  NULL AS depth,
  NULL AS path,
  package_name,
  cve_count
FROM multi
ORDER BY section, cve_count DESC NULLS LAST, package_name, cve_id, affected_package;
EOF
